title: Practical Common Lisp
summary: Peter Seibel's 2006 Google TechTalk on Practical Common Lisp, framed by the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis and Paul Graham's Blub paradox. It shows Lisp features such as condition restarts and its generic-function object system.
why: HN remembers it as the memorable explanation of restarts and multiple dispatch, referenced whenever those features come up.

quote.text: I will forever think of this talk by Peter Siebel
